name: Shishiou Rin
source:
[b]A Firm Believer in the Small-Chest Appeal[/b]

"Late again? Must be tough being sandwiched between all these cute girls every day, huh~!"

The petite loli student council president with a signature sunny smile. 
Rin's small stature puts her in the spotlight, but she's no pushover. Having set her sights on our hero, she loves pulling strings from up high. For a student council president, she's surprisingly dynamic - though her moods swing with the calendar.

On Dating:
"Who knows... but if the right guy came along, we might just end up being one of those lovey-dovey couples..."

Charm Points:
Wears her heart on her sleeve, takes the initiative in romance

Character Gap:
Acts confident but turns shy when pursued; quite the crybaby

[Based on the official site]
